# FrameGuard

FrameGuard is bounded visual change control for AI agents.

## Agent behavior

- Inspect the document before proposing a change.
- Keep protected Logo and Legal elements unchanged.
- Present proposed changes visibly for human review; human decisions are not agent tools.
- Apply only the human-approved subset after scoped one-use authorization in FrameGuard.
- Keep exports local and secret-free.
